_about: Test links for Chris. Each entry becomes a link: https://dramadex.pages.dev/<page>.html#test=<name><knobs>. The page opens with these lines, this mode and the steps on screen, logs the ears, and sends the log to the site's store as miclog/t-<name>-<time> when he taps a result. Read them with: python read_test_logs.py <name>. Names: lowercase letters and digits, 12 at most. Lines are script positions (the i of a line), never the text. Steps must not quote the play.

airpodspc.title: AirPods on the PC
steps: Connect your AirPods to the PC, then press Start.
Say each of the 8 lines as it comes up.
On two of the longer lines, stop partway, say "next word", then carry on.
If the AirPods drop out or the mic stops hearing you, tap Mark this moment.
When the run ends, tap It worked or It went wrong.

nextwordios.title: Next word on the iPhone
steps: Connect your AirPods to the iPhone, then press Start.
On every line: say the first few words, say "next word", wait for the word, then say it and carry on.
The moment it stops hearing you, tap Mark this moment, then keep going if you can.
When the run ends, or you give up, tap It worked or It went wrong.

holdios.title: Mic held open on the iPhone
steps: Do this one after the Next word test. Connect your AirPods, then press Start.
Say each of the 8 lines as it comes up, as you normally would.
If the AirPods drop out or the mic stops hearing you, tap Mark this moment.
At the end, write in the box whether the sound was quieter or different from normal, then tap a result.
